## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run e2e` pass
- [ ] New content is original (or its source and license are in `CREDITS.md`) and uses pronoun tokens
- [ ] If generation changed on purpose, snapshots are updated and the diff looks right
- [ ] If a section's shape changed, `version` is bumped and `upgradeCharacter()` handles the old shape
- [ ] User-visible changes are noted in `CHANGELOG.md`
